name: awesome-skills
description: Norman's skill pack bundle for Kimi Code: installs every plugin in this repo (awesome-skills core, html-ppt, navi-recap, navi-testing, product-recap, vault-skills, vpn-skills) as one plugin. Kimi Code's GitHub install only reads a repo-root manifest, so this bundles the per-plugin packages under plugins/.
author: Norman

interface.shortDescription: All of Norman's skills as one Kimi Code plugin.
